page.overview:
Who is Costin V?

Emperor Costin V was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 1993–2000 AG) during the Era of the Princes, succeeding Menemtahe IV as ruler of the Corrino Imperium. Costin V was a son of Emperor Costin IV.

Costin was succeeded in 2000 by his son Sidir VIII.
